knowledge_items.parameter: 制备方法总体流程 overall preparation process
knowledge_items.value: 一锅法三步：(1) CCS+LS+Fe3O4+PEG+SA水中混合；(2) 加PEI+环氧氯丙烷反应得粘性溶液；(3) 滴入CaCl₂溶液析出微球，冻干72h

context.核心原料: 羧化壳聚糖(CCS)、木质素磺酸钠(LS)、海藻酸钠(SA)、Fe3O4、聚乙烯亚胺(PEI)、聚乙二醇(PEG)

evidence.evidence_text: 一种磁性生物基吸附剂的制备方法，其特征在于，包括以下步骤：(1)将羧化壳聚糖、木质素磺酸钠、磁性颗粒、聚乙二醇和海藻酸钠在水中混合得到混合液；(2)将所述的混合液与聚乙烯亚胺和交联剂反应，得到粘性溶液；(3)将所述的粘性溶液加入钙离子溶液中，得到磁性生物基吸附剂SA‑CCS‑LS@Fe3O4

knowledge_items.parameter: FTIR表征结果 FTIR characterization
knowledge_items.value: Fe-O峰590cm⁻¹；SA羧酸盐峰1421→1409cm⁻¹迁移；LS磺酸基1045→1021cm⁻¹迁移；新C-N峰1573cm⁻¹；Ca²⁺交联峰567cm⁻¹

evidence.evidence_text: Fe3O4谱图中在590cm‑1出现了Fe‑O峰...SA的谱图中在3390cm‑1出现了钝峰为‑OH的伸缩振动，羧酸盐的对称伸缩振动峰值在1421cm‑1...对于SA‑CCS‑LS@Fe3O4‑1，源自木质素磺酸钠C‑O拉伸振动峰值(1145cm‑1)和羧化壳聚糖分支上伯醇的酚羟基消失，而在1573cm‑1处出现新的C‑N振动峰...海藻酸钠和羧化壳聚糖中的羧酸盐基团从1421cm‑1迁移至1409cm‑1，木质素磺酸钠中磺酸基团从1045cm‑1迁移至1021cm‑1...在567cm‑1出现钝峰可能是由于Ca2+与木质素磺酸钠、海藻酸钠、羧化壳聚糖交联

knowledge_items.parameter: 吸附机制分析 adsorption mechanism
knowledge_items.value: LS和CCS与环氧氯丙烷交联修饰氨基；SA和CCS的羧酸盐基团与Ca²⁺交联；CCS的氨基/羧基和PEI的亚胺基提供吸附位点；LS的磺酸基增强配位

context.交联机制: 环氧氯丙烷交联LS/CCS/SA的氨基
context.凝胶化: Ca²⁺与羧酸盐基团（SA/CCS/LS）交联形成蛋盒结构
context.吸附位点: CCS的氨基+羧基、PEI的亚胺基、LS的磺酸基
context.选择性来源: 伯氨基染料与吸附剂的特异性作用

evidence.evidence_text: 这表明木质素磺酸钠、海藻酸钠和羧化壳聚糖都与环氧氯丙烷发生交联反应以修饰氨基。海藻酸钠和羧化壳聚糖中的羧酸盐基团从1421cm‑1迁移至1409cm‑1，木质素磺酸钠中磺酸基团从1045cm‑1迁移至1021cm‑1反应后，表明羧酸基团和磺酸基团参与了与Ca2+的交联

knowledge_items.parameter: 壳聚糖包覆的功能

functions: 增加对肿瘤细胞粘附性
context.description: PEG改性壳聚糖包覆的多重功能

evidence.evidence_text: 对壳聚糖进行聚乙二醇修饰，可以减少血浆蛋白对壳聚糖包衣介孔聚多巴胺纳米粒的吸附作用，从而减少巨噬细胞对壳聚糖包衣介孔聚多巴胺纳米粒的摄取，延缓载药纳米粒从血浆中被清除的过程，并通过增强的透过及滞留效应，进一步提高壳聚糖介孔聚多巴胺纳米粒的被动靶向功能
通过壳聚糖修饰将中空介孔聚多巴胺纳米载体表面电性改变为正电，增加中空介孔聚多巴胺载体对肿瘤细胞的粘附性

knowledge_items.parameter: 磁改性羧甲基壳聚糖复配絮凝剂制备方法 Preparation method of magnetic modified CMC flocculant
knowledge_items.value: 四步法：(1)羧甲基壳聚糖溶于弱酸-水+Fe3O4→悬浮液；(2)无氧下+Fe2+盐→混合液；(3)+Na2S水浴60-90°C→负载FeS的CMC溶液+交联剂→凝胶→洗涤干燥；(4)+阴离子聚丙烯酰胺→复配絮凝剂

evidence.evidence_text: 步骤一、将羧甲基壳聚糖溶解于弱酸-水溶剂中形成均一溶液，再加入Fe3O4磁性纳米颗粒搅拌均匀...步骤二、在无氧条件下，将步骤一制备的悬浮液与Fe2+盐溶液混合...步骤三、将步骤二制备的混合液与Na2S水溶液混合，经60～90℃水浴加热...步骤四、将步骤三制备的磁改性羧甲基壳聚糖、阴离子聚丙烯酰胺溶解于溶剂中

knowledge_items.parameter: 制备方法核心流程
knowledge_items.value: 四步法：混合→交联→冷冻干燥→疏水改性

context.step1: 生物基聚合物+吸附剂+增强剂+水，0-90°C搅拌500-5000rpm 30s-10h
context.step3: 倒入模具→冰箱冷冻成型→冷冻干燥（或常温/加热/超临界CO₂干燥）
context.step4: 浸泡/气相沉积/喷涂疏水改性剂
context.hydrophobic: PDMS乙醇溶液浸泡5min（比实施例1多2min）
context.special: 降解性能测试对象（30天降解率88%）

evidence.evidence_text: 将生物基聚合物、吸附剂、增强剂与水在0~90℃条件下以500~5000r/min搅拌混合30s~10h，得到第一混合液；将交联剂在0~90℃条件下加入第一混合液中以100~10000r/min搅拌混合30s~30min，得到第二混合液；将第二混合液倒入模具中成型干燥，得到生物基泡沫；将生物基泡沫加入疏水改性剂进行疏水改性，即可得到生物基泡沫吸附材料。
称取1.5g卡拉胶粉末、1.5g蒙脱土粉末、0.25g二氧化硅纤维溶于100g去离子水中...将生物基泡沫浸泡在聚二甲基硅氧烷的乙醇溶液中5min进行疏水改性

knowledge_items.value: 柠檬酸改性β-环糊精1-2份 + 去离子水(1:25) + EDC 2-3份 + NHS 1-2份 → 活化30-40min → 加入壳聚糖溶液(210-213份, 浓度2-4%) → 加入改性微球和改性活性炭 → 快速搅拌5-10min → 倒入模具 → 静止过夜凝胶 → 去离子水反复浸泡 → -80°C冷冻20-25min → 冷冻干燥

evidence.evidence_text: 向1-2份柠檬酸改性β-环糊精中1:25加入去离子水，再加入2-3份1-(3-二甲氨基丙基)-3-乙基碳二亚胺盐酸盐和1-2份N-羟基琥珀酰亚胺，搅拌活化30-40min后，加入到210-213份壳聚糖溶液中，再加入(2)、(3)中所得物料，快速搅拌5-10min，倒入模具，静止过夜，凝胶后用去离子水反复浸泡，于-80℃低温冷冻20-25min，再冷冻干燥，制得生物基复合吸附材料

evidence.evidence_text: pH=3时，复合微粒对3种金属离子的吸附率均低于55%。因为在强酸条件下，氨基以-NH₃⁺形式存在，对金属离子的络合能力大大减小。随着pH值增大，吸附率迅速增大，pH值达到7时，吸附剂吸附金属离子的效果最佳。但pH值太高时，溶液中存在的OH⁻会与金属离子反应形成沉淀

knowledge_items.value: 六种主要机制：静电相互作用、π-π相互作用、疏水作用、酸碱作用、氢键、孔隙填充，以及这些机制的组合

evidence.evidence_text: the adsorption mechanism of BPA on adsorbent primarily involves electrostatic interaction, π-π interactions, hydrophobic interaction, acid-base, hydrogen bonding, pore filling, or a combination of these interactions

knowledge_items.source_file: 仿生文献库/论文/第6组-功能仿生/2024-Cheng-chitosan-cellulose-separation-membrane-review.pdf

knowledge_items.parameter: pH对BPA吸附的影响 pH effect on BPA adsorption
knowledge_items.value: pH 2-8范围内对去除效率影响较小；pH 9-11时BPA吸附效率下降(BPA在pH>8开始去质子化，阴离子形态与带负电吸附剂表面产生静电排斥)

context.BPA_ionization: pH<8.0为分子形态，pH 8.0和9.0分别开始一级和二级去质子化
context.mechanism: 去质子化后BPA阴离子与带负电吸附剂表面产生静电排斥

evidence.evidence_text: Several studies have observed that variations in pH within the range of 2 to 8 had little effect on the removal efficiency of the adsorbents. However, the BPA adsorption efficiency declined in a pH range of 9–11

knowledge_items.source_file: 仿生文献库/论文/第6组-功能仿生/2024-Cheng-chitosan-cellulose-separation-membrane-review.pdf

knowledge_items.parameter: BPA吸附等温线和动力学模型 Adsorption isotherm and kinetic models for BPA
knowledge_items.value: Langmuir和Freundlich模型在描述BPA吸附时无显著差异(碳材料:7个Langmuir vs 9个Freundlich)；碳材料、COFs、MOFs和天然高分子多符合PSO动力学模型(化学吸附主导)；粘土、COFs和MOFs多符合PFO模型

context.kinetics_PSO: 碳材料、COFs、MOFs、天然高分子多符合伪二级动力学
context.kinetics_PFO: 粘土、COFs、MOFs多符合伪一级动力学

evidence.evidence_text: there is no significant difference in the proportion of the two models... there are 7 Langmuir models and 9 Freundlich models in the BPA adsorption on carbon materials... in most BPA adsorption onto carbon materials, COFs, MOFs and natural polymers, the adsorption of BPA on adsorbents was more correlated to PSO, indicating that chemical forces, like valence forces, may significantly impact the adsorption process

knowledge_items.source_file: 仿生文献库/论文/第6组-功能仿生/2024-Cheng-chitosan-cellulose-separation-membrane-review.pdf

knowledge_items.parameter: 膜分离技术对BPA的去除效率比较 Membrane separation efficiency comparison
knowledge_items.value: BPA截留效率顺序：RO > NF > UF > MF；MF通过吸附机制(非尺寸排阻)去除BPA，去除率18-95%；NF去除率>90%；RO最为有效但成本最高

evidence.evidence_text: the rejection efficiency of BPA decreases in the following order: RO > NF > UF > MF... BPA rejection efficiency by the above membrane technologies ranges from 18 % to >99.9 %

MF is rarely used on its own in practical applications... Dong et al. found that hollow fiber microfiltration membrane has been able to remove from 20 to 95 % of BPA from drinking water, and BPA removal by MF membrane is because BPA was adsorbed on particulate matter

knowledge_items.value: MF膜材料BPA吸附容量：PA(161.29 mg/g) > PVDF(80.00 mg/g) > 硝酸纤维素(18.02 mg/g) > PTFE(1.56 mg/g)

evidence.evidence_text: the maximum adsorption capacity of these MFMs was polyamide (PA) (161.29 mg/g) > PVDF (80.00 mg/g) > nitrocellulose (NC) (18.02 mg/g) > PTFE (1.56 mg/g), and the adsorption rate was PVDF (K1 = 2.373 h⁻¹) > PA (K1 = 1.739 h⁻¹) > NC (K1 = 1.086 h⁻¹)

knowledge_items.parameter: NF膜去除BPA的机制 NF membrane BPA removal mechanism
knowledge_items.value: NF膜通过尺寸排阻、吸附、静电排斥和Donnan效应的组合作用去除BPA；NF膜通常带负电荷(表面可离解基团电离)，与BPA阴离子产生静电排斥

context.membrane_charge: 通常带负电荷(表面可离解基团电离)
context.integrated_processes: NF-Fenton, NF-臭氧化, NF-吸附可提高去除率

evidence.evidence_text: NF membranes would slightly charge (typically negative charge) because of the dissociation of the membrane surface ionizable groups... rejection from NF membranes may be attributed to the combined roles of steric, adsorption, charge exclusion, and transport effects together

knowledge_items.parameter: DFT和MD在BPA吸附机制研究中的应用 DFT and MD in BPA adsorption mechanism studies
knowledge_items.value: DFT可计算电子结构和吸附能(如rGO-BPA吸附能6.71 kcal/mol, GO-BPA 11.85 kcal/mol)；MD可模拟吸附动力学和分子间相互作用(如π-π堆积、色散力、氢键)；EDA可分解不同吸附力的贡献比例

context.DFT_application: 计算电子结构、吸附能、反应中间体、能量势垒
context.MD_application: 模拟吸附动力学、表面扩散、吸附构型稳定性
context.EDA: 能量分解分析，定量不同吸附力的贡献比例

evidence.evidence_text: Wang et al. also proposed that the low adsorption energy (Ead) of rGOs + BPA (6.71 kcal/mol) is lower than that of GOs + BPA (11.85 kcal/mol) by DFT calculation. The lower Ead of rGOs + BPA (<10 kcal/mol) indicates that physisorption is mainly the interaction mechanism

knowledge_items.parameter: MF膜去除BPA的机制 MF membrane BPA removal mechanism
knowledge_items.value: MF膜孔径(0.1-10μm)大于BPA分子尺寸(7.52Å)，BPA去除主要通过大颗粒吸附和膜表面吸附(非尺寸排阻)；去除率18-95%

context.mechanism: 吸附效应(大颗粒截留或膜表面吸附)，非尺寸排阻

evidence.evidence_text: the pore size of the MF membrane being larger than the molecular size of BPA, MF is not effective in impeding its passage. As a result, the retention mechanisms responsible for removing BPA by MF are mainly the adsorption effect of large particulates and membrane structure rather than size exclusion and physical sieving

knowledge_items.parameter: 吸附剂剂量对BPA吸附的影响 Effect of adsorbent dose on BPA adsorption
knowledge_items.value: 吸附量与吸附剂剂量正相关(更多表面积和结合位点)，但非线性；低剂量时表面位点未充分利用，高剂量时存在收益递减效应

context.low_dose: 表面位点未充分利用，吸附容量较低
context.high_dose: 收益递减，增加吸附剂不再显著提高容量

evidence.evidence_text: the extent of adsorption is usually directly proportional to the increase in the adsorbent dose... At lower doses, the available surface sites on the adsorbent may not be fully utilized... At even higher doses, there may be a point of diminishing returns

knowledge_items.parameter: 温度对BPA吸附的影响 Temperature effect on BPA adsorption
knowledge_items.value: BPA吸附通常是放热过程(温度升高吸附容量下降)；但某些材料因表面化学或孔结构变化在高温下吸附容量反而增加

context.general_trend: 放热过程，温度升高吸附容量通常下降
context.exceptions: 某些材料因表面化学或孔结构变化，高温下吸附容量可能增加
context.mechanism: 高温破坏BPA与表面的相互作用，减弱吸附力

evidence.evidence_text: theoretically, the adsorption of BPA onto solid surfaces is an exothermic process... However, the specific effect of temperature on BPA adsorption can vary depending on the properties of the solid surface... certain sorbent materials may exhibit increased adsorption capacities for BPA at higher temperatures

evidence.evidence_text: functionalized materials for adsorbents and membrane materials can be designed via (i) surface modification... (ii) pore size and distribution customization... (iii) multi-functional materials development... (iv) biomimetic design: mimic biological processes or enzyme structure to develop functionalized materials that can effectively remove BPA

evidence.evidence_text: 壳聚糖，黏均分子量8.99×105，脱乙酰度94%

壳聚糖分子链上含有大量的氨基，氨基在酸性条件下很容易发生质子化效应，使其与金属离子配位形成螯合物，起到吸附金属离子的作用。壳聚糖支链上还有大量的羟基，羟基对氟离子也有一定的吸附作用

context.title_zh: 纤维素基气凝胶制备工艺：溶胶-凝胶法与冻干主导的三维多孔结构
context.summary_zh: 纤维素基气凝胶通过溶胶-凝胶法(溶液制备→凝胶化→老化→干燥)制备，冻干是最常用干燥方法(创造更多介孔但可能产生冰晶聚集)。纤维素纳米晶(CNC)、纳米纤丝(CNF)、细菌纤维素(BC)是三种主要纳米纤维素类型。生物气凝胶可承受80%应变而不破裂，远优于二氧化硅气凝胶。
context.embedding_text_zh: 纤维素基气凝胶是第三代生物气凝胶，通过溶胶-凝胶法制备：(1)溶液制备(纤维素本身已有聚合物网络，衍生物需交联剂)→(2)凝胶化(羟基形成分子间氢键和范德华力)→(3)老化(强化孔隙防止干燥坍塌)→(4)干燥。三种主要干燥方法：常压干燥(得干凝胶，成本低但收缩大)、超临界干燥(得气凝胶，CO2临界温度31.3°C，成本18-59 USD/m²)、冷冻干燥(得冷冻凝胶，最常用，-20至-80°C，成本152 USD/m²，创造更多介孔但冰晶可能导致聚集)。纤维素纳米材料分三类：纤维素纳米晶(CNC，棒状100-2000nm×2-20nm，酸水解提取)、纤维素纳米纤丝(CNF/MFC)、细菌纤维素(BC)。生物气凝胶机械性能优异，可承受80%应变而不破裂，比脆性二氧化硅气凝胶更耐用。纳米纤维素表面丰富羟基可在C2/C3/C6位点进行化学修饰引入氨基、巯基、羧基等功能团。

knowledge_items.parameter: 7种电纺膜类型与目标污染物对比

advantages: 标准膜: 高孔隙率+高比表面积+柔韧
双层膜: 改善机械性能+稳定渗透通量
复合膜: 增强功能+更好分离能力
光催化膜: 无需预/后处理+稳定+低成本
陶瓷中空纤维: 更好稳定性+耐高温+高通量
纳米纤维素膜: 快速重金属去除+环保+高通量

limitations: 标准膜: 机械强度差+污染问题
双层膜: 渗透性下降+昂贵+加工困难
复合膜: 能耗高+加工困难+环境问题
光催化膜: 污染发生+UV损伤聚合物膜
陶瓷中空纤维: 高重量+开发成本大
纳米纤维素膜: 强度低+保质期短+制备时间长+能耗高
PVDF膜: 膜污染可能严重

context.needle_collector_distance: greater → finer fibers (more flight time, more stretching, more evaporation)

context.summary_zh: 综述静电纺丝纳米纤维膜(ENMs)在水净化中的应用(Int. J. Environ. Sci. Technol. 2022)。7种膜类型对比：标准膜(高孔隙/柔韧/机械差)、双层膜(脱盐/机械改善)、复合膜(蒸馏/能耗高)、光催化膜(免预处理/UV损伤)、陶瓷中空纤维(Cr去除/耐高温)、纳米纤维素膜(重金属/高通量但寿命短)、PVDF膜(微粒>90%截留)。10+种聚合物体系：PVA/PU(89.9mg/g染料)、NYLON6(浊度99%/COD 64%)、PAN(细菌99.9999%)、PVDF、PSF、壳聚糖、纤维素。6种无针电纺规模化技术：旋转辊NanoSpider(50-300nm)、气泡、锥形线圈、双层流体(12倍增产)、珠链、盘式。RO能耗3-4kWh/m³。
context.embedding_text_zh: 静电纺丝纳米纤维膜水净化综述(Int. J. Environ. Sci. Technol. 2022)。7种膜类型：标准/双层/复合/光催化/陶瓷中空纤维/纳米纤维素/PVDF。PVA/PU膜89.9mg/g染料吸附；NYLON6电纺膜浊度改善99%+COD降低64%(vs商业33%/15%)；PAN膜细菌去除99.9999%；PAN/β-CD从15%提升至25%染料去除；PVDF膜>90%微粒截留。RO能耗3-4kWh/m³。6种无针电纺：旋转辊NanoSpider(50-300nm)、气泡、锥形线圈、双层流体(12倍增产)、珠链。生物基膜：纤维素(5种)+壳聚糖(5种)=10种体系。关键挑战：机械强度差+膜污染+纳米颗粒泄漏风险。

knowledge_items.parameter: 壳聚糖对Cr(VI)的两种主要吸附机制
knowledge_items.value: 静电吸附机理和吸附-耦合还原机理

context.electrostatic: Cr(VI)以CrO₄²⁻/HCrO₄⁻/Cr₂O₇²⁻形式与吸附剂表面阳离子静电吸引；低pH有利（质子化），高pH不利（排斥）
context.adsorption_reduction: 步骤1: Cr(VI)阴离子通过静电吸附固定在正电荷官能团上；步骤2: 还原性基团将Cr(VI)还原为Cr(III)；步骤3: Cr(III)部分释放到溶液中，部分通过螯合作用被吸附固定
context.evidence_of_reduction: 吸附六价铬后的吸附剂表面呈现三价铬的绿色
context.reference: Park et al. [6]; Hasan et al. [7]

evidence.evidence_text: 对于六价铬离子来说，主要包含属于离子交换的"静电吸附机理"和属于化学吸附的"吸附-耦合还原机理"。Park等提出了六价铬的吸附耦合还原机制：首先，六价铬阴离子通过静电吸附被固定在吸附剂的正电荷官能团上；随后，吸附剂表面的还原性基团将六价铬还原为阳离子的三价铬；最后，阳离子Cr(III)由于与吸附剂表面的正电荷官能团的排斥作用而被释放到溶液中

knowledge_items.parameter: 壳聚糖酸性不稳定性的改性策略
knowledge_items.value: 交联形成不溶于水的网络结构提高酸稳定性；接枝引入活性官能团增强吸附性能；复合引入更多吸附位点

context.problem: 单纯壳聚糖在酸性溶液中不稳定会发生溶解，造成吸附剂流失
context.crosslinking: 戊二醛、环氧氯丙烷、DEO、N,N'-亚甲基双丙烯酰胺等交联剂
context.grafting: 有机小分子（吡啶、氯乙酸、乙二胺）和有机高分子（聚丙烯酰胺、PEI、聚多巴胺、聚1-乙烯基咪唑）
context.composite: 有机材料复合（离子液体、聚吡咯）和无机材料复合（磁性纳米粒子、GO、碳纳米管、黏土、金属氧化物）

evidence.evidence_text: 利用壳聚糖分子中含有的大量氨基和羟基官能团，通过化学交联或者化学接枝的方法对壳聚糖进行化学改性是克服壳聚糖自身吸附能力不足、酸稳定性差的有效途径之一

knowledge_items.value: Amino (-NH2) at C2 position and hydroxyl (-OH) at C3 (primary) and C6 (secondary) positions per glucosamine unit; -NH2 has stronger influence than -OH due to lower electronegativity of N

knowledge_items.parameter: Primary adsorption mechanism - complexation/chelation / 主要吸附机制-配位螯合
knowledge_items.value: Metal ion complexation (chelation/coordination) is the leading sorption mechanism; Cu2+ forms Cu-chitosan complex via coordination interactions with lone pair electrons from -NH2, -OH, -COOH groups

context.complex_formation: Cu2+ forms [Cu(NH2)(OH)2X] where X is H2O or -OH from C3
context.bridge_model: Cu(II) chelated with multiple -NH2 groups from same or different chains
context.pendant_model: Cu2+ bounded with single -NH2 group and oxygen atoms with coordination bonds
context.electron_transfer: free-electron doublets in N atoms react with Cu2+ via chelation

evidence.evidence_text: Metal ion complexation (also known as chelation/coordination) is the leading sorption mechanism to remove Cu2+ by chitosan-based adsorbents. It is a chemisorption process that refers to the coordination interactions between lone pair electrons comprising functional groups (-NH2, -OH, -COOH, etc.) of adsorbents and metal ions

knowledge_items.value: pH < 5.3: zero/minimal complex formation; pH 5.3-5.8: one -NH2 forms metal complex; pH > 5.8: second -NH2 incorporated forming [Cu(-NH2)2]2+ stable up to pH ~7.7; pH > 7.7: Cu(OH)2 precipitation

evidence.evidence_text: there is zero or minimal complex formation occurred between metal and chitosan at pH < 5.3, while the NH2 group formed a metal-adsorbent complex at pH between 5.3 and 5.8
when pH > 5.8, another -NH2 group is incorporated with [Cu(-NH2)]2+ complex...The complex was stable up to pH ~7.7, but it formed Cu(OH)2 that precipitated at above pH = 7.7

knowledge_items.parameter: Electrostatic interaction and pHpzc / 静电相互作用与零电点
knowledge_items.value: At pH > pHpzc, adsorbent surface deprotonated creating negative charge that attracts cations; at pH < pHpzc, surface protonated causing electrostatic repulsion with Cu2+

context.pHpzc_definition: pH at which total charge of adsorbent surface is zero
context.pH_gt_pHpzc: surface deprotonated, negatively charged, attracts cations
context.pH_lt_pHpzc: surface protonated, positively charged, electrostatic repulsion with Cu2+
context.example: composite chitosan bio-adsorbent pHpzc = 5.8; adsorption higher at pH > 5.8, plateau at pH = 7.0
context.extreme_high_pH: OH- dominant, forming insoluble metal-hydroxide salts (surface precipitation)

evidence.evidence_text: At pH > pHpzc, the hydrogen-containing functional groups on the adsorbent surface are deprotonated owing to excessive concentration of hydroxyl ions, creating a negatively charged adsorbent surface that attracts cations

knowledge_items.parameter: Ion-exchange mechanism / 离子交换机制
knowledge_items.value: At pH < pHpzc, positively charged Cu2+ exchanges with H+ ions on protonated adsorbent surface; slower kinetics than other mechanisms

context.process: Cu2+ exchanges with H+ ions
context.limitation: further pH decrease increases competition between H+ and Cu2+ for binding sites
context.kinetics: slower than electrostatic and complexation mechanisms

evidence.evidence_text: At pH < pHpzc, the adsorbent surface is protonated, thus increasing the number of H+ ions on the adsorbent surface, and positively charged Cu2+ ions exchange these H+ ions

context.langmuir: best for homogeneous surface with monolayer coverage; more dominant for chitosan
context.freundlich: best for heterogeneous surface with multilayer adsorption; fits chitosan/WASC (R2=0.9949 vs Langmuir 0.3979)
context.redlich_peterson: combines Langmuir and Freundlich for wide concentration range; rare use
context.endothermicity: increasing KL with temperature indicates endothermic chemisorption dominance

evidence.evidence_text: The Langmuir isotherm model is the best one to fit experimental data when metal ions are adsorbed on a homogeneous adsorbent surface with monolayer coverage...Typically, Langmuir isotherm is more dominant than Freundlich isotherm, especially for removing heavy metal ions by chitosan

knowledge_items.parameter: Adsorption kinetics models / 吸附动力学模型
knowledge_items.value: Pseudo-second-order (PSO) dominates (chemisorption rate-limiting); Pseudo-first-order (PFO) fits initial phase at high concentration; intra-particle diffusion and Elovich models in some cases

context.pso: chemisorption is rate-limiting; adsorbate-adsorbent bonds formed through complexation; best fit for most experimental data
context.pfo: valid at high initial adsorbate concentration; mathematically fitted at initial phase
context.intra_particle_diffusion: pore diffusion critical when rate-limiting; Morris-Weber equation criticized for solid-solution interface
context.elovich: explains chemisorption nature; fits well at higher metal concentrations (200 mg/L)
context.multi_metal: PSO valid for simultaneous removal of multiple metals; PFO for specific metal

evidence.evidence_text: the literature showed that PSO kinetic model fits perfectly with most experimental data obtained for removing heavy metal ions using chitosan-based adsorbents. In the PSO model, chemisorption is the rate-limiting step, where adsorbate-adsorbent bonds are formed through the complexation mechanism

knowledge_items.value: pH=5时吸附率95.22%；pH≥6时接近100%

biomimetic_narrative.problem_definition: 自然界中生物大分子（如多糖与蛋白质）通过多官能团协同与特定金属离子结合以实现生理调控或解毒；对应水处理中Pb(II)的高效捕获、选择性去除及吸附剂便捷回收的工程挑战。
biomimetic_narrative.biological_solution: 进化出富含羧基与氨基的生物聚合物网络，利用静电吸引、配位键合及空间限域实现离子的高效固定；本设计通过羧基化壳聚糖与纳米纤维素双组分协同提供密集-COOH/-NH₂位点，结合Ca²⁺离子交联构建三维水凝胶网络，实现334.92 mg/g的高容量吸附与准二级化学吸附动力学。
biomimetic_narrative.key_features: 必须保留特征：双羧基化组分协同配位、氨基孤对电子结合、Ca²⁺离子交联三维网络、pH/水响应性溶胀收缩；可灵活调整特征：CYCS与CNC质量比、CaCl₂交联浓度、珠体粒径及表面孔隙结构。
biomimetic_narrative.design_mapping: 生物大分子多齿配位→CYCS/CNC双组分-COOH/-NH₂协同吸附位点；生物基质水合网络→CaCl₂离子交联水凝胶珠形态；细胞膜/基质离子交换→-COO⁻静电吸引与-NH₂配位机制。软约束建议：维持pH 2-5以保障官能团离子化状态；控制干燥-溶胀循环应力以防结构疲劳；优先采用湿珠形态以优化传质与回收。
biomimetic_narrative.explainability_anchors: 仿生故事线：从天然生物聚合物的多官能团离子捕获机制出发，抽象出“双组分协同+氨基配位+三维水合网络”的分子仿生范式；设计溯源：基于壳聚糖与纳米纤维素的天然生物骨架，通过羧基化改性提升溶解性与位点密度，利用Ca²⁺仿生交联原理构筑易分离水凝胶珠，完成从分子识别机制到宏观材料形态的跨尺度映射。

engineering_constraints.explanation: 最优吸附pH为4，pH过低导致-COOH质子化削弱静电作用，需将体系严格控制在2-5范围内以维持官能团活性。
干燥后表面褶皱且强度略弱，实际工程中建议湿态操作或优化交联密度以维持珠体结构完整性与循环稳定性。
依赖CaCl₂形成离子交联网络，交联程度直接影响溶胀率、内部传质速率与固液分离回收效率。
